profile.name: Scott Moss
profile.tagline: AI engineer, moving into AI research
profile.description: Scott Moss is an AI engineer moving into AI research. He builds AI systems, teaches on Master.dev and works with teams as an applied AI architect.
profile.intro: I’ve spent years building AI systems that run in production. Now I’m moving into research, focused on how those systems fail, how to measure them and how to make them safe. I teach what I learn on Master.dev.

items.title: Build an Agent that Never Sleeps
items.description: Background agents that observe, act, recover from interruptions and ask for help.

items.title: Harness Engineering & Agent Orchestration
items.description: Workflows, sandboxes, memory and multi-agent handoffs for production agents.

items.title: Applied AI Engineering Fundamentals
items.description: Context engineering, RAG and eval harnesses for AI features that improve over time.

items.title: AI Agents Fundamentals, v2
items.description: A CLI agent with tool calling, evals, context management and human approval.

items.title: Build AI-Powered Apps with OpenAI and Node.js
items.description: Chat interfaces, semantic search, document Q&A and function calling with OpenAI.

sections.title: Work with me
sections.lead: I’m an applied AI architect. I’ve built AI systems at {netflix} and as a two-time {yc} founder.
sections.body: If your team has AI demos that never reach production, or production AI it doesn’t trust, I can help. I design the architecture, set up the evals and work alongside your engineers until it ships and they own it.
